facts.fact: ITWeb Africa reports that Gabon launched its first sovereign data centre, built with ST Digital, with a first phase that includes a 65 m2 colocation space and hosting for banks, public administrations, telecom operators and businesses; the launch date is not given, so as_of is the article's published date.
facts.system: ST Digital Gabon data centre, Nkok

facts.fact: ITWeb Africa, citing the Gabonese government portal, calls the ST Digital data centre in Gabon a Tier III facility; the certifying body is not named.
